source: <single_phrase_mode><time=0>And we are continuing with our program! <time=2220><time=2580>This is The First Radio, and your host is, as always, Max Golovnya... <time=7480><time=7740>I hope the song I just played reached the members of the expedition that set out to explore the Moscow Wasteland and went off the air just over a week ago.<time=16160><time=16780>I, for one, would like to believe there’s something wrong with their transmitter... <time=20880><time=21300>Look, we’re all worried, but...<time=22820><time=22820>In any case, hoping for the better is the most constructive thing we can do now, since panicking is definitely not going to help anyone. <time=30580><time=31120>We’re also not going to help anyone by setting out to rescue them, risking our lives in addition to theirs without proper preparation.<time=38540>

source: <single_phrase_mode><time=4420>I still remember life before the War.<time=6940><time=11620>I remember that we used to be different, used to live up there, on the surface.<time=16680><time=18240>We used to be the masters of the whole world.<time=20760><time=22700>We built gigantic cities of glass and steel, we crossed the oceans at will, and we also conquered the skies.<time=32000><time=34580>There used to be seven billion of us.<time=36920><time=37840>We were not born for life in the tunnels. I was born to breathe fresh air and I remember it!<time=44720><time=82120>The seven billion were wiped out by the Last War. Only fifty thousand managed to survive underground, with the Surface poisoned, burnt and teeming with horrible monsters.<time=93840><time=95200>One day the radiation on the surface might subside, and our grandchildren or their grandchildren might be able to return there.<time=103520><time=104140>At least, that's what my brothers-in-arms from the Order believe.<time=107860><time=110300>Basically, there was no hope for us right off the start.<time=113500><time=114080>Still, we, humans, are just too bad at surrendering.<time=117500><time=118820>We tried to make the best of what we had, we banded together and worked to make the Metro our new home.<time=125040><time=128320>After all, it might well be the only place left on Earth for humans to live.<time=135620><time=137340>For a time, we thought we could make it...<time=140160><time=141620>But, regrettably, the war didn't kill our bad habits.<time=147260><time=158080>In the relative safety of the tunnels, corruption festered,<time=162260><time=163160>and when danger came from above the ground, only a few of us stood against it, our numbers dwindling by the day.<time=171640><time=186060>But I remember we were born for a better life, and I can’t accept that I’m destined to grow old and die underground.<time=194220><time=195300>I don’t care if I’m called an idiot, but if even a single shard of the old world still exists out there, I have to find it.<time=204740><time=212660>Between endless years of hopeless existence and even a single moment of hope, I must choose hope.<time=219780><time=220660>I must find that signal!<time=222400>

source:
Observation journal, new outpost. Important! Spotted the ex-captain, armed, heading East, hasn't noticed us, we updated the base and are waiting for the hunters.
What do we need them for?! He's getting away! We gotta act! Let's get him with a pincer movement, just the two of us is enough!
Tom said it clearly, we must wait for the hunters.
Tom, always Tom! Soon you won't know to wipe your ass unless he gives you the order to! He didn't put everything exactly!
We should have called Klim, he'd give us sane orders, not like that windbag with his crap!
Yeah, your darling Klim would have told you: "Get him or I'll have your head", end of story!
The Captain isn't your average Joe, what would you do if he gave us the slip?
You're just a coward, that's all, you and your Tom. You must take risks if you want to achieve anything!
Yeah, right... Explain to me then, why does Klim work for Tom then, and why do you work for me?
We'll see about that...
You'll see?! Watch the Captan, you idiot! I'll fuck you up if you lose him... "We'll see about that"!
Now I wasted a tape because of you!

Sins?<time=19350><time=19730>What was he even talking about?!<time=21130><time=21510>Our last generator is out because of those things, people died!<time=25110><time=25840>He didn’t stop at sins, he went on to say that we are to fight the demons of electricity with prayer, fasting and charms!<time=34530><time=34950>Charms?! There’s no pleasing some people...<time=88330><time=88620> hat difference does the color of a cat make as long as the cat catches the rats?<time=93420><time=95510>October 5th<time=96530><time=97170>Silantius is right, we have to get rid of the rest of the equipment,<time=101170><time=101170> it does attract the ball lightning, and it’s not like we are<time=104330><time=104330>ever going to restore the normal supply of electricity without our generator.<time=108240><time=108970>So, what’s the point in taking a risk by keeping the stuff? We can live without it...<time=114730><time=116400>October 7th<time=117550><time=118600>Roman is dead... That catfish...<time=122910><time=123840>Yes, there was no real need to gather everyone, we could have gone through it gradually...<time=129420><time=129420>And it is true that some of the actual useful stuff got thrown into the river, too - but such things are bound to happen...<time=136130><time=136350> It’s hardly worth starting a commotion over and jumping into the water!<time=140260><time=141460>He definitely could feel the power seeping through his fingers, but to go so far as to raise a hand against Silantius?<time=148420><time=149400>And it happened exactly the way the man told us it would, too...<time=152420><time=154260>December 31st<time=155710><time=156330>The tape is coming to an end, just as this year...<time=159460><time=160130>God willing, our troubles are going to end with it, too...<time=162970><time=163680>We’re no longer alone in this world, the God is with us, so who could stand against us?<time=169000><time=169510>Not me, that’s for sure...<time=171130><time=172000>This means, this log is done for...<time=175310><time=175860>A New Year’s Eve is a perfect time to turn a new page. Besides, as Father Silantius says, electricity is a sin...<time=185110>

source: <single_phrase_mode><time=0>But let’s wrap up this sidetrack and get back to weather...<time=2840><time=2960>I completely neglected to report the most important piece of information I have in that regard...<time=7700><time=7940>The one you’re all so eager to know!<time=10520><time=10980>So, here goes nothing...<time=12020><time=12440>The thermometer outside of the studio’s window currently says it’s six degrees below zero,<time=17200><time=17400>which is an outright luxury for Vyshny Volochyok, all things considered.<time=21340><time=21720>It seems that the nuclear spring that’s been hinted at since forever by every optimistically-inclined forecast enthusiast out there, has finally arrived!<time=30880>

source: <single_phrase_mode><time=5530>Parting with my friends was hard...<time=8550><time=9220>But for them, the Colonel's death signaled the end of their journey <time=13130><time=13860>and the beginning of a new life on the shores of Lake Baikal.<time=17710><time=18480>For me, the loss became a threshold. <time=22220><time=22530>Between the Order and my own life.<time=25060><time=25950>Between duty and my dream to see Dad again.<time=29600><time=30370>And, like Artyom before, I chose to pursue my wild dream. <time=35660><time=39280>Along the way, I sometimes felt that the trees, ruins and leaning wire posts vanishing behind were just an endless movie reel projected onto a ragged screen just for me, <time=51640><time=52710>a lonely late-night viewer in an empty theater...<time=55710><time=56840>Yet every morning, the Sun rising dead ahead brought another change of scenery, <time=62770><time=63570>making sure that I was in fact getting closer to the Pacific.<time=67260><time=78440>One step at a time, slowly but steadily, <time=81970><time=82820>no matter the obstacles on the way.<time=85020><time=87000>One day, sitting in a recliner on my Dad's porch, <time=91240><time=92400>I might be tempted to start a book about this trip or something...<time=95930><time=100570>One day, but not here, not now. <time=105400><time=106280>I see the town that's to become my springboard for a leap across the Ocean, and I smell salt in the air.<time=112280><time=112730>If there really is even a slight chance of me ever getting home, I will find it here!<time=118600><time=118610> <time=118620>
